title: Send feedback
intro: Found a problem or have an idea? Tell us what happened. No account needed.
detailsPlaceholder: What happened? What would make Crew better?
detailsHelp: 10–1,500 characters. Please don't include passwords, API keys or private conversations.
privacy: We only submit what you enter and the page path to our private issue tracker. We do not attach chats, recordings or API keys.
successBody: Your feedback has been received. You can keep exploring Crew.
error: Could not send your feedback. Your text is still here; please retry or use email.
unavailable: The online feedback form is unavailable right now.
emailHint: This opens your email app; you need to send the message there.
